precisionQuestionContext.implementation: Precision search ranks by distinct query-term coverage weighted by rarity within the exact observer/timeline/as-of corpus, prioritizing substantive speech over mixed narration. Repeated words in one monologue do not increase their frequency score. It considers24 eligible unique exchanges. A complete matching exchange keeps its immediate preceding spoken question or immediate player answer/reciprocal input, rather than unconditionally expanding four exchanges. Adjacency is supporting evidence, never an answer-resolution receipt. Explicit source-linked continuity remains protected separately. Question hits keep the next actual answer and NPC acknowledgment, then a directly adjacent explicit return question and its NPC answer, within four following turn positions. An answer hit also keeps a preceding question and the adjacent return exchange. Statements keep at most one adjacent reply exchange with an explicit spoken response opening; reply hits retain the preceding NPC statement. These cues do not classify agreement, refusal, intent, resolution or native effects. Every step enforces observer/time visibility and stops at hidden or unrelated dialogue; no session merge or semantic answered-state inference is performed.

Statement/reply controls preserve negative and qualified speech and speaker ownership, reject private/quoted/hypothetical cues, stop at hidden replies, enforce session/time cutoffs and bound the explicit reply hop. artifactDeploymentHook.implementation: .codex/hooks/enforce-reign-validation.ps1 resolves each literal canonical ReignServer/scripts/Deploy-LocalWsl.ps1 path in the paired sibling or workspace junction; the script enforces successful reports and artifact hashes without rebuilding.
artifactDeploymentHook.gates: Explicit deployment authorization remains required. Direct builds, chained builds, legacy deployment scripts and copies outside the canonical roots remain denied; the exception never exempts an entire command.
artifactDeploymentHook.verification: HookEnforcementTests runs isolated PowerShell hook processes for canonical deployment/read paths and negative legacy, unrelated-copy and chained-command cases. It performs no deployment or service operation.

sovereignDemeanor.proofSelection: Use 36 risk-based pairwise natural-language cases instead of a full cross-product: every authority class, effective danger band, personality extreme, relationship posture, and scene type appears; authority-by-personality plus the designated danger/relationship/scene pairs are covered.

Add a paraphrase or extra seed only for an actual failed, borderline, or measured-inconsistent response, using --case so already-proven equivalence classes are not rerun.
sovereignDemeanor.releaseGate: Zero hard political-conduct safety violations, at least 95% calibrated-demeanor agreement, no deterministic fallbacks in the initial provider matrix, and no more than 10% compact repairs. gauntletXmlPreviewer.conversationRetryState: individual-chat-generation-failed, individual-chat-recovery-available and individual-chat-recovery-review are provider-free preview-only. gauntletXmlPreviewer.actionBuilderContract: ui-open --target action-builder opens a temporary provider-free sentence builder. gauntletXmlPreviewer.eventTranscriptContract: The provider-free quick check contracts.social_event_readable_transcript requires both Social and Wilderness Event rows to expand for wrapped RichText, separate turns by 12 pixels, and top-align each fixed-height speaker label with the first text line. gauntletXmlPreviewer.visualStyleRule: Every literal standalone Color, Brush.Color, and Brush.FontColor declaration and every literal native-augmentation color must use an exact modern palette token. Alpha-only modal variants may change alpha but must retain the RGB identity of an exact palette token. White is permitted as an identity tint for a registered image sprite, a declared calibration-editor control, and the user-authorized textAction role for protected action sentences and native selected text. gauntletXmlPreviewer.overlayAlphaCompoundContract: shape compound accepts 1..16 noncompound apertures with per-child shape/aperture and optional rectangle alphaFade. Every child retains its own transparency, bounds and failure evidence in analysis.apertures. Common thresholds are inherited without child overrides. Surround and exterior checks exclude the declared union only; corners and transparent RGB rules remain unchanged. Rectangle fade alpha is checked per pixel within one rounding level; the remaining clear region still passes ordinary aperture gates. Existing --self-test covers compound and fade regressions; report schema remains reign-ui-overlay-alpha-audit-v1.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.renderTargetSelectionContract: Optional --targets accepts exact comma-separated catalog IDs; base interface IDs include every declared preview state, explicit state IDs select that state, and native augmentation IDs select that target. Unknown, empty and duplicate IDs fail before browser launch. Scoped reports set partialScope=true and retain requestedTargets plus full catalogInterfaceStateCount, catalogAugmentationCount and catalogPrefabCount; full catalog inventory, binding, asset and per-case diagnostics remain enforced. Direct manipulation and custom scale checks remain enabled. Aggregate native parity readiness reports not-run-partial-scope. A scoped pass never establishes full-catalog completion or native acceptance; retain partial reports outside the global readiness discovery tree.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.approvedReferenceFidelityRule: Every standalone render reports authoritative referenceSurfaceBounds. A catalog referenceSurfaceElementId selects exactly one visible fixed owning artwork; missing or duplicate candidates fail closed. Otherwise the settled largest visible fixed 16:9 Gauntlet surface is used. Fidelity registers by translation and uniform scale only, compares the approved reference and conservative masks at the observed render scale, scales edge search accordingly, weights saturation by visible luminance, and excludes only contract-declared dynamic regions plus the Calibration Overlay's reported movable selection geometry. Missing or out-of-bounds geometry fails closed. Individual Chat uses current XML and sprite assets without a preview-only legacy shell override.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.typographyParityRule: Fixed titles, section labels, ornament-integrated captions, and fixed control ornaments are exact pixels baked into the approved shell or a registered approved-reference sprite and must not survive as hidden or transparent runtime TextWidgets. Every remaining live TextWidget and EditableTextWidget, including literal runtime controls and runtime-bound values, must explicitly declare Brush.Font=ReignSerifDynamic, the module-local Cormorant Garamond Medium SDF face, and preserve the contract's exact per-widget brush, face/weight/style declarations, font size, frozen palette token, opacity, tracking, alignment, position offsets, and wrapping geometry. XML and asset-chain parity do not prove rendered glyph parity; reviewed native 2560x1600 captures and human visual acceptance are the first gate, and defects found there must be corrected before the remaining supported 1080-or-higher resolutions are attempted.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeBridgeArmingContract: After each campaign game start, both provider-free campaign capture batches, capture-native-matrix.ps1 and capture-native-augmentation-batch.ps1, self-arm the ReignLiveTest bridge for 240 minutes, require the resulting arm receipt to report ok=true and armed=true before the first ui-open, and fail closed otherwise. They never rely on a stale or external prior arm. This capture-only arming does not advance campaign time or save the campaign.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.initialScreenReadinessContract: The native-initial-screen capture route invokes ReignLiveTest game start-menu with a bounded wait and never treats process existence or elapsed time as UI readiness. ReignLiveTest inspects the current Bannerlord process log rgl_log_<pid>.txt, tails at most 512 KiB with shared read/delete access, requires the exact GauntletInitialScreen::HandleActivate marker to remain observable for two continuous seconds, and only then returns main_menu_ready with readinessMarker, readinessLogPath, and stableInitialScreenSeconds=2. If the marker is absent or ceases to be observable, readiness resets or times out fail-closed and no InitialScreen screenshot may be taken.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeHeadlessSnapshotContract: Native ui-snapshot registration is headless and records only the requested production interface. Native capture fails closed if any calibration-overlay movie, widget, action, or supportUi evidence appears.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeVisualReviewContract: A reviewed native case must contain a reign-ui-native-visual-review-attestation-v1 receipt created only by accept-native-case --reviewed with the exact confirmation 'I confirm this native capture matches the approved Reign reference for all fixed visuals and typography'. All nine criteria must be present, known, and true: approved fixed visuals exact; differences confined to declared dynamic regions; packaged ReignSerifDynamic/Cormorant Garamond face and weight; typography size hierarchy; capitalization and tracking; gold/gray semantic text colors; alignment, baseline, and wrapping; native glyph hinting and rasterization; and no unexpected colors or shapes. Dynamic text content, portraits, and scene art may differ only in their declared regions; their fixed framing and typography remain governed. Missing, false, unknown, legacy, or unreviewed attestations remain pending and cannot pass native parity.

approvedComponentComposition.contract: A declared state may recompose unchanged hash-verified approved Government components at frozen geometry. gauntletXmlPreviewer.inventoryContract: Every Gauntlet prefab beneath ReignBeta/GUI/Prefabs, every movie loaded by ReignBeta client source, and every PrefabExtension application that augments a native Bannerlord prefab must have an exact catalog entry and dedicated preview fixture, regardless of filename prefix. The audit discovers prefab files, LoadMovie calls, native augmentation targets, patch classes, XPaths, and source ownership from source and fails when a new, missing, extra, unresolved, or multiply-described surface drifts from inventory; runtime variants remain explicitly labeled, and support overlays are explicitly labeled previewer-only with nativeInjection=false.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.bindingContract: The provider-free audit resolves every XML binding and nested DataSource against both the interface-specific preview fixture and the production client ViewModel/member graph, verifies every Command.* target, and rejects cross-interface fallback data. Intentional empty list states require an explicit rationale.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.editingContract: Click selection retains exact file, line, XML path, Id, binding, and geometry context. Moving a stretch-to-parent label or event-transparent child moves its owning button or nearest bounded parent by default; Alt explicitly moves the selected child. Resize handles have fixed editor sizing and cannot inherit global button minimum dimensions or cover the move surface. The rendered audit physically clicks, drags, resizes, and undoes through browser input, verifies the nested selection remains visible, and proves the workspace source hash is unchanged until guarded source apply.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.scaleContract: Auto scaling derives DoNotUseCustomScaleAndChildren from the current XML root or primary canvas instead of a filename list. Locked fixed canvases keep Bannerlord's base resolution scaling while ignoring player custom UI scale; responsive screens and compact popups keep their declared runtime behavior. At 3440x1440 the engine exposes a 2580x1080 logical root at UIContext.CustomScale 1.33333325, so a locked 16:9 workspace remains uniformly scaled and horizontally centered with ultrawide side gutters rather than stretched. The rendered audit proves locked, unlocked, and explicit-override cases at 1920x1080 and 120% UI scale.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeEvidenceSelectionContract: Native authority selects only the exact retained resolution/configured-UI-scale matrix case requested by the preview controls, reloads on either selector change, and requires the snapshot's loaded-prefab SHA-256 to match current workspace source before using engine scale or captured state. A latest snapshot from another scale or source revision is never substituted as exact evidence.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.codexContract: The bottom dock connects through a previewer-owned loopback WebSocket bridge to a dedicated Codex App Server task. Each turn includes the selected widget token, bindings, geometry, diagnostics, pending patch, and install state. Codex may edit only the workspace and may never deploy, install into Bannerlord, launch Bannerlord, or mutate a campaign.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.codexE2eContract: The headless end-to-end audit selects a real Royal Council widget, captures the outbound turn/start payload, requires a unique receipt proving every editing-context field reached the dedicated Codex task, and compares guarded Reign source fingerprints before and after the required no-op turn.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.installContract: Workspace source and installed ReignBeta prefab hashes are shown independently for the current prefab and in one all-prefab summary. Source apply and game installation use separate explicit confirmations, unchanged-source SHA-256 guards, timestamped backups, Windows-safe atomic replacement with a non-null rollback path, and post-copy hash verification. Installation remains available while Bannerlord runs and reports that the affected interface must be closed and reopened to load the new movie XML. A source-success/install-failure response must preserve and report the successful source mutation rather than claiming no change occurred.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.fixtureContract: Interface-specific coherent sample content is the default preview state. Captured game-state text and list shape are a separate explicit opt-in and are disabled whenever the snapshot prefab SHA-256 does not match current workspace source, preventing stale native text from contaminating another interface or revision.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeFixtureSafetyContract: Every runtime Reign movie and every campaign-backed native augmentation has a shared ui-open target. The pre-campaign native InitialScreen uses the visible game start-menu route. Calibration-only Court Petition, correspondence, dialogue, social-event, diplomacy, notable-generation, Memories Book, Royal Council, and native-augmentation fixtures are temporary and provider-free and never save the campaign; Royal Council receives a non-persistent four-domain transcript, reports calibration-fixture identity, and must remain at zero provider calls. Standalone fixtures cannot write conversations, letters, social events, memories or memory images, relationship, reputation, political-pressure, or campaign-action state, including official council records. Native production screens may temporarily change bounded in-memory UI/conversation state but are closed without advancing or saving. ReignUiCalibrationOverlay remains previewer-only with nativeInjection=false and is never opened, attached, actioned, or included in a native snapshot.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeAugmentationContract: The previewer composes each source-discovered Reign PrefabExtension into the exact allowlisted installed Bannerlord base prefab, preserves patch class/source/XPath attribution for click-to-Codex editing, resolves installed brush/sprite-derived constants, and scopes diagnostics to the Reign-modified subtree. Virtual native compositions never use direct XML apply/install; Codex changes the authoritative C# patch source. Provider-free composition is preflight and never substitutes for native screenshots.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.parityContract: The provider-free rendered audit must capture all 165 cataloged browser interface states (26 unique XML prefabs, including distinct Social Event and Wilderness Event fixtures, normal and pregnancy-warning Individual Chat states, and the previewer-only Calibration Overlay) and all 7 composed native augmentation targets at 1920x1080 and 3440x1440 with zero browser diagnostics and retained screenshot hashes, yielding 344 cases. Native release confidence covers 26 runtime interface states plus 7 native augmentation targets and requires runtime-snapshot bounds and exact native captures through ReignLiveTest ui-open/ui-snapshot at every resolution and UI scale in the catalog target matrix; the pregnancy warning is additionally exercised and accepted as the nested provider-free modal state declared by nativeRuntimeStateAcceptance beneath the native Individual Chat target. The first native acceptance pass is 2560x1600, and every defect found there must be corrected and revalidated before another resolution is attempted. Each snapshot retains the prefab SHA-256 from movie-load time and records the currently installed hash separately, so a live install cannot falsely relabel an already-open movie. Workspace, installed, and loaded-snapshot hashes must agree before native comparison. ReignUiCalibrationOverlay remains browser-preview support only and never contributes a native movie, payload, action, or acceptance surface. Native augmentation preflight additionally requires an in-game screenshot of the patched native screen before parity can pass.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeAcceptanceContract: audit-native-parity.mjs evaluates all 33 native surfaces (26 runtime interface states and 7 native augmentations) fail-closed. Each surface needs a reign-ui-native-parity-acceptance-v1 manifest for every catalog resolution/UI-scale case, a reviewed exact-resolution native screenshot bound to its reign-ui-window-capture-v1 verified-foreground Bannerlord receipt, zero diagnostics, and current source/installed or patch/base-prefab hashes. Runtime interfaces additionally require a matching non-empty headless runtime snapshot containing no calibration-overlay movie, widget, action, or supportUi payload. ReignUiCalibrationOverlay is excluded from native acceptance. The pregnancy-warning browser state does not add a separate surface: the existing Individual Chat surface additionally requires its nested reign-ui-native-runtime-state-acceptance-v1 manifest at <evidence-root>/individual-chat/states/individual-chat-pregnancy-warning/acceptance.json, with one inherited-matrix state receipt per exact parent case. Native Bannerlord augmentations use the reviewed in-game screenshot as rendering authority and may include an optional runtime snapshot when the host movie exposes one. capture-native-matrix.ps1 opens every runtime interface state provider-free at one required resolution/UI-scale case, captures exact foreground pixels plus runtime geometry, records every case and required nested state as unreviewed, emits a contact sheet, closes each live run, and stops Bannerlord without saving. calibration_workflow.py accept-native-case validates and records one reviewed matrix case without weakening these gates. Missing, partial, stale, unreviewed, or hash-mismatched surface or nested-state evidence remains pending; --require-pass exits nonzero until all surfaces and required nested states pass.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeBatchContract: The standalone batch runner refuses an already-running game, requires an explicit save name and one catalog matrix case, verifies that the requested UI scale equals Bannerlord's configured UIScale, records the separate positive snapshot UIContext.CustomScale without comparing it to the configuration value, uses only provider-free ui-open/ui-snapshot routes, waits for capture-ready UI state, and fails closed unless Royal Council reports its calibration fixture, a non-empty transcript, and zero provider calls. The verified screenshot helper uses a per-monitor-DPI-aware capture thread plus bounded attached-input-thread retries to acquire Bannerlord foreground ownership when another desktop window has focus, proves the target before copying pixels, and restores the prior foreground window afterward. When the verified engine snapshot exceeds the desktop and Windows reports clamped client bounds, the helper triggers Steam's foreground DirectX backbuffer screenshot, requires the exact requested pixel dimensions, converts that image into the evidence PNG, copies the source JPEG into the exact case evidence directory, verifies its SHA-256, and removes only the exact run-created Steam screenshot and same-name thumbnail while retaining original-path and cleanup receipts plus the distinct verified-foreground-steam-backbuffer mode. PrintWindow full-content capture remains available only for an exact off-screen client; blank output is rejected, and virtualized and physical client bounds are recorded separately. Both batch runners record acceptance manifests directly beneath the same evidence root consumed by audit-native-parity.mjs; each runner never advances or saves the campaign, stages all evidence as reviewed=false, and emits reign-ui-native-capture-batch-v1 plus reign-ui-native-contact-sheet-v1 evidence for explicit visual review. A zero-stage failure retains the complete per-case evidence and exits nonzero without replacing the original error with a contact-sheet error. capture-native-augmentation.ps1 verifies one already-open production Bannerlord screen and exact foreground-client dimensions. capture-native-augmentation-batch.ps1 opens all 7 cataloged production augmentation targets through bounded provider-free routes, requires game start-menu to return the process-log-backed GauntletInitialScreen::HandleActivate readiness evidence defined by initialScreenReadinessContract before capturing InitialScreen, uses one no-save test2 campaign session for the remaining native screens, records ready target identity and fixture evidence, closes each screen, and stops Bannerlord without saving.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.nativeDisplayMatrixContract: The display-matrix orchestrator requires exact confirmation, refuses a running game, and selects only catalog resolution/UI-scale cases. Release support starts at 1920x1080 and covers 1080p, 1440p, 1600p, 3440x1440 and 3840x1600 ultrawide, and 3840x2160 4K; lower resolutions are intentionally unsupported. It creates byte-for-byte backups of BannerlordConfig.txt and engine_config.txt beneath the workspace evidence root, changes only UIScale, display_width, display_height, and an explicit validated capture display_mode while Bannerlord is stopped, delegates each case to the provider-free standalone batch or, when -NativeAugmentations is explicit, the production native-augmentation batch, and stops Bannerlord after every case. A finally block restores both original files and verifies their SHA-256 hashes even after capture failure. Its reign-ui-native-display-matrix-v1 checkpoint report retains the surface type, child batch/contact-sheet paths, configuration backup path, restoration proof, game-stop proof, and failure without advancing or saving the campaign; every child screenshot remains reviewed=false until explicit visual review.
gauntletXmlPreviewer.readinessUiContract: The previewer displays provider-preview coverage for all 95 browser interface states while installed-runtime and reviewed-native readiness cover all 33 native surfaces (26 runtime interface states and 7 native augmentations). It lists exact deployment/native pending targets and includes the same bounded readiness state in selected-widget Codex context. gauntletXmlPreviewer.announcementReadingContract: News and ruler-to-ruler diplomacy share a 732x480 scrolling reading column with 24-unit left-aligned body text. No shrinking or truncation. campaignStorage.confirmation: delete Reign campaigns with no saves

nonDiplomacyActionProbe.scope: Up to eight distinct unchanged natural player requests per live Individual Chat run, drawn from the 66-command non-diplomacy catalog. nonDiplomacyActionProbe.cooperationOverride: Optional positive-case request-only scope is authorized by the server only for the currently executing natural-language send, matching live run, game instance, enrolled Current, ready Save Sync and exact fixed willingness directive. nonDiplomacyActionProbe.evidence: Live report preserves each unchanged player text, NPC reply, override authorization receipt, queued action IDs/types, bounded native terminal wait, before/after gauntlet snapshots, action ledger status, result codes and effects. providerObservationPolicies.contract: The default `providerPolicy=provider_free` still requires the clean existing tripwire. For an independently authorized real workload, `providerPolicy=observe_configured` observes a healthy unarmed guard, zero blocked attempts, one stable provider-server instance and nondecreasing process dispatch counters; armed, malformed, missing, restarted or reset evidence fails collection. Reports explicitly identify the policy and observed dispatch delta. These counters include nonbillable upload/retrieval stages and all process users, so they are neither billable-call totals nor spend accounting. This read-only option never releases a marker, changes settings, dispatches a provider or grants generation/budget authority. Resolve ownership and funding separately before enabling producers; a successful observation is not full-feature or performance acceptance.

campaignPerformance.readinessRetryContract: Readiness uses a synchronous connection-specific retry-suppression scope. A PostgreSQL statement error exits and rolls back the whole read-only transaction; neither contention nor stale-plan recovery reissues a statement in that aborted transaction. Nested scopes restore their predecessor and do not affect other connections. Stale plans are unprepared after rollback for a later observation. Actual exclusive-lock contracts require the original55P03 with zero generic retries, normal autocommit retry remains a negative control, and a following readiness is healthy.
campaignPerformance.relationshipCaseEvidence: The focused relationships aggregate retains at most512 caseResults with bounded192-character code IDs, suite-qualified duplicate checks, passed flags, total count, invalid-ID and truncation flags. Other aggregates retain their existing default output. The task proof requires complete valid evidence, exact required case IDs, all cases passed, process exit0 and the exact successful artifact identity; no new native or provider authority.
campaignPerformance.publicationContract: The worker serializes the detached timing DTO directly without an intermediate JSON DOM, preserving identical windows and host publication identity. Direct-vs-DOM contracts require semantic JSON parity and less than half the allocation. Native main-thread callbacks expose slowItemCount and lastSlowItemDurationMs; callbacks at least16ms log a code-only caller name at most once per five seconds. These include wall-time GC interference and do not prove causality.
campaignPerformance.marriageSnapshotContract: political_marriage_only_v1 retains unchanged nobles/clans/kingdoms and native header values, ambientHeroCount for telemetry, and empty legacy heroes/presenceGroups arrays. The marriage endpoint accepts old full inputs and the known compact kind, rejecting unknown kinds. Ambient daily input is unchanged. Isolated production processor contracts compare deterministic decisions, quotes, roll rows, refusals and chemistry deltas under rollback; generated receipt IDs and timestamps are excluded. This is synthetic parity, not a real native snapshot equivalence claim.
campaignPerformance.campaignLockDiagnostics: campaign.work_lock_slow logs helper scopes held or waiting at least1000ms after ownership is released. Code-only owner/stage, heldMs and waitMs are bounded scalars; ownerAtWaitStart is not attribution for the whole wait. Direct Monitor owners are unknown. Reentrant/exceptional ownership restoration and real contention are isolated provider-wait contracts. Marriage stage logs candidate/eligible counts, maximum leader time and total time. Neither diagnostics nor timing grants runtime/provider authority.
campaignPerformance.queueFailurePolicy: Five independent fixed GET queue sources plus native scalar projection. Each queue request has a four-second client deadline. A failed or scope-rejected source is disabled for the rest of that run to avoid stacking abandoned server work; timing backfill continues with explicit failed observations and an overall failed collection. Caller cancellation remains cancellation. Readiness requires fresh unique observation and stable campaign generation. Native identity, shape, sequence or explicit provider-tripwire failures abort.
campaignPerformance.readinessReadContract: The fresh World Test readiness view performs no schema migration. PostgreSQL reads use a read-only transaction with 200ms lock and 3000ms per-statement deadlines; these are not a whole-request server deadline. File-store reads occur before retaining database table locks. Missing schema fails closed until normal heartbeat/worker initialization. Contracts cover active writers, access-exclusive timeout, missing index without repair and missing table rejection.
campaignPerformance.politicalBatchContract: Keep single-flight wire batches of at most64. Select in one frame, capture full native rows in later frames with4ms between-row and8-row bounds, prepare and compare detached DTOs on a worker, then commit in one native callback guarded by campaign instance/state/timeline, interval and captured profile reference/revision. Individual native operations and commit are not preemptible or rollback transactions. FIFO dispatch drains at least one item with4ms between-item and200-item limits. Runtime counters expose captured/acknowledged heroes, completed batches/sweeps and refresh age. Retain cadence, fairness and saved political revisions.
campaignPerformance.relationshipStatusContract: Marriage queue diagnostics read one cached immutable document header, never parse the full queued snapshot. Upload and acknowledgement parsing run on workers; exact head and period acknowledgement guards remain. Ambient uploads capture campaign/timeline on the native thread, join one bounded worker task per scope, parse detached durable texts outside the publisher lock and retire only the exact accepted text. A contended native outbox observation returns clientOutboxDaysKnown=false with a conservative pending sentinel1; it never produces an unknown zero. Preparation retains its authoritative locked read. Existing stable observations and clock gates remain. Native heartbeat publishes at most13 named section duration/collection/thread records; these are wall time and all-process GC counts, not pause durations or causal proof.
campaignPerformance.populationLookupContract: Tavern maintenance keeps its real cadence, atomic full-pass order, four-creation budget, daily work and synchronous local entry. A pass-scoped own-ID lookup replaces repeated global Native Hero.Find scans. Duplicate/missing identities still use Native authority; missing saved identities still fail rather than regenerate. Live status is read from the same objects. Buffers are cleared on pass exit/load. Town grouping retains insertion order and creation updates. Daily tavern/wanderer work uses the existing population phases; global wanderer10% chance and native RNG order remain unchanged. No new population work queue.
campaignPerformance.diagnosticProjection: Numeric due/transit/clock/blocked/duration/wait/known/chars/thread scalars are retained, including bounded heartbeat sections and upload stage evidence. Strings keep the existing narrow UTC/status/presence-only policy; raw documents, narratives, IDs in arrays and credential bodies are excluded. Six sources and3078 total-entry ceiling remain unchanged.
campaignPerformance.windowSemantics: Monotonic actual-span windows close on the next application tick after one second. A long interval is counted once in a longer window; no fabricated empty windows or repeated rolling maxima. Sequence and retention reveal missed data. GC deltas are collection counts, not pause time. Foreground requires both sampled interval endpoints to belong to the game process. Native/render waits are included; GPU present time is not measured.
campaignPerformance.isolation: Read-only cached HTTP observations of the exact enrolled run-owned Current, current campaign/timeline, aligned Save Sync, armed bridge and fresh heartbeat. No native command, provider request, time/save control, settings changes or queue clearing. Existing provider-free guard must report clean; prior marker ownership is not changed. Evidence uses new run-owned files under the canonical build working root; archive completed evidence according to storage policy.
campaignPerformance.evidence: observations.jsonl retains numbered timing windows, fixed phase aggregates, bounded scalar queue counters, native module MVID, instance/save identity and poll self-time. campaignPerformance.acceptance: Pending native validation, observer on/off comparison, sustained fastest fast-forward and aging, queue stability, game-only restart, and independent visual evidence. Collection does not replace these requirements.

campaignTest.controllerArtifact: Guarded campaign operations execute only the ReignLiveTest.exe sibling built by the same successful validation report as the running MCP assembly. The retired ReignBeta/server/app Windows package is not a controller source.

Checkpoint and advance project saveName, worldDay, nativeSave, and saveFinalization from the completed nested save command, then wait up to 45 seconds for five stable seconds of matching current post-save runtime telemetry. They fail closed unless Save Sync is aligned and ready, diplomacy is idle, the native relationship daily-input outbox is empty and idle, World History is empty and idle, the native save is complete, and finalization names the requested save. Full run evidence remains in the referenced live-test report.

Optional reign_advance_campaign_test observeGovernmentNews=true (controller --observe-government-news --no-save) preserves real government bulletins across heartbeat, advance, catch-up and interrupted-advance recovery, holds native time while they are open and records up to32 observed event IDs. End the exact owned UI inspection run before checkpoint restoration; closing the screen alone does not end that persistent run.
campaignTest.passiveWorldEscapeMenuRecovery: Before native settlement waiting begins and throughout guarded advancement, the client closes only Bannerlord's already-open native MapScreen Escape menu. This prevents an attached or freshly restored campaign from remaining paused behind Return to the Game; the recovery count is recorded in the world_advance result. No synthetic input is sent and no other inquiry, screen, or menu is dismissed by this recovery.

warCouncil.riverGeometryContract: The complete official river mask is projected into the 16,384-pixel master at its actual variable-width water footprint, clipped only by the exact land gate, carved into the same unified land/water contour as seas and lakes, and engraved through the shared coastline pass so both banks are native contour lines rather than fixed-width centerline overlays.
warCouncil.runtimeTileEncodingContract: The lossless 16,384-pixel authored master is exported as exactly sixteen 4,096-pixel RGB PNG runtime tiles. warCouncil.mapSourceProvenance: The exact playable border, 440 settlement coordinates, 39 top-level strategic mountain placements, 39 top-level bridge placements clustered into 33 physical sites, and seven semantic terrain material layers come from the installed War Sails NavalDLC Main_map scene and read-only editor exports. All 69,500 source tree transforms come from the installed Main_map flora.bin FLR2 transforms; the raster renders naturally spaced exact-root representatives by culling only colliding appearance stamps and never moving or synthesizing geography. Coastline and river geometry come from hash-audited official NavalDLC world_map TPAC textures, excluding the editor-only outer mesh. Registration must prove the north-up land transform keeps all 440 settlements on land and the river texture's vertical texture-to-world transform places 32 of 33 physical bridge sites within five world units of the authored river mask; the remaining official coastal-approach site is reported explicitly.
warCouncil.bridgeIllustrationContract: All 32 river-crossing bridge sites are baked as restrained strict-orthographic top-down timber deck and abutment engravings with no side elevation, visible arch, façade, isometric angle, or game-style 3D shading. Each footprint is rotated to the shortest exact local crossing, sized to the measured official river-water span, and extended only far enough to meet both banks. The single official coastal-approach bridge remains at its exact Main_map scene coordinate and is reported separately.
warCouncil.bakedRasterContract: warCouncilScrollFrameImageAvailable and warCouncilSettlementImagesAvailable must both be false: scroll construction, wear, clutter, all 440 settlement drawings, and canonical names are baked into the one continuous editor-derived map raster. warCouncilOuterFrameImageAvailable remains true because the stationary Court-style screen frame is intentionally separate from the moving sheet.
warCouncil.acceptance: On an exact armed disposable Current, prove native open/back/close and full-screen snapshot geometry; opening immediately pauses campaign time and closing restores the prior time mode. The interface uses one close 44x fixed strategic scale with bounded click-drag panning beneath a clipped viewport inside a fixed Court-style Reign frame; the rolled parchment and cartographer clutter travel with the map and appear only when its outer limits are reached. The player main party and every other active player-clan and player-kingdom hero-led party appear as a consistent 108-pixel black-painted infantry, missile, mounted, or naval wooden figure with a Roman number; every detected foreign party appears as a consistent 108-pixel brown display-only intelligence figure. Town, castle, and village drawings plus their canonical medieval labels are baked into the same continuous parchment raster at exact world coordinates rather than added as runtime wooden miniatures; towns are visually largest, castles are 75% of town scale, and villages are 50%. Clicking a player marker selects and visibly highlights its matching lord card. The right column is a scrollable roster of every available player-kingdom lord with stable non-flickering native portraits, party size/composition, read-only current order status, raven dispatch, or guarded mobilization. The independently selected War Councilor changes no normal lord function or office; no selection uses the ruler. Every open refreshes capital-centered intelligence. Tactics radius is 70 world units at 0 and 520 at 300, while Leadership foreign-party detection is 25% at 0 and 90% at 250; player-realm parties remain unconditional. Selection and fallback persist across checkpoint/restart without migrating an old Marshal mirror. Prove portraitRevision is unchanged across repeated paused refreshes. The reduced legend is followed by an alphabetic scroll list of every town, castle, and village, and center-settlement centers exact rows without changing zoom. Realm-involved battle reports render the complete PARTY VS ENEMY PARTY title bold red; unrelated reports remain ordinary. All previously bare information boxes use transparent event-pass-through Reign frames visually derived from the map frame. The dedicated raven composer uses the same sealed letter record as Correspondence and the letter appears there. The pan-map action and native click-drag move the map within bounds without changing the fixed scale or issuing/removing orders; token dragging, mouse-wheel input, and right-click never issue or remove orders, and wheel input over the map leaves the fixed scale unchanged. The clean engraved sepia antique-atlas map is one 16,384-pixel master exported as a 4x4 grid of exactly sixteen lossless RGB PNG 4,096-pixel runtime tiles passed directly to Bannerlord without generic managed decode/re-encode normalization. Its audit must prove the audited 69,500-transform flora source with non-overlapping exact-root representatives, 39 top-level strategic mountain anchors plus editor-height-derived mountain ranges, 39 top-level bridge placements clustered into 33 physical bridge sites, seven editor material layers, 440 settlements, zero procedural static placements, exact PNG headers/dimensions, and pixel-exact tile reconstruction. Rivers use the complete official mask at their actual source-variable widths, are carved into the original unified land/water contour before terrain and parchment rendering, and receive paired engraved banks from the same shared coastline pass as seas and lakes; no river is skeletonized, redrawn as a fixed-width centerline overlay, or tinted blue. The raster retains exact world-coordinate alignment and bakes its rolled-scroll edges, continuous wear, roads, bridges, terrain, vegetation, settlements, labels, folds, and cartographer clutter into the master with no visible seams; runtime children are limited to live party, detection/selection, tooltip, and invisible input state. Kingdom strengths, battle result/loss/capture reports, mobilization safety, cancellation, correspondence visibility, and guarded checkpoint/restart persistence are proven.

reportDelivery.contracts: CampaignReportPolicyTests proves exact delivered-report completion gates, delivered/read receipts, source separation and truthful terminal/guidance wording. RunCorrespondenceTransitAssertions exercises the actual correspondence API with isolated PostgreSQL for immediate delivered completion reports, exact retry identity, one retained body, contact visibility, read-after-lost-ack replay and exclusion from guidance replies.
reportDelivery.nativeProof: Naturally signed scouting must show actual native movement, local native observations, a delivered campaign_command_report letter and matching native report_letter_delivered history before exactly one fulfillment. Persisted ReportLetterPending/DeliveredId/NextReportLetterAttemptDay keep retries bound to the frozen exact report. No provider is used for report generation or delivery.
reportDelivery.limits: Offline source/policy/database fixtures do not certify native motion, save/reload, arbitrary provider speech or UI rendering. Terminal reports from older saves are not retroactively regenerated. Existing structured observations deliberately omit report prose; exact production report evidence and correspondence inbox reads remain read-only.

campaignCommand.saveAuthorization: The MCP campaign-test service must prove an enrolled campaign match and the exact armed run-owned Current save before any feature profile starts.
campaignCommand.baselinePolicy: The user-provided baseline is immutable even when its name contains Command or Test.
campaignCommand.naturalLanguagePolicy: Every Campaign Command language test must use plausible player speech rather than schema-like or ceremonial test directives. Coverage includes addressed and unaddressed direct orders, polite and indirect requests, casual speech, shorthand, punctuation variation, ambiguous fragments, corrections, and stateful clarification follow-ups. Bare confirmation and cancellation phrases are verified through the deterministic draft gate.
campaignCommand.naturalLanguageOraclePolicy: Expected plans preserve every explicitly spoken stage, including travel before a later objective, while native semantic actions remain distinct: retreat and nearest-safe-settlement language must resolve to withdraw rather than generic move, and only genuinely unresolved targets or material details belong in the ambiguity set.
campaignCommand.llmMatrixEvidence: The final-fingerprint provider pass uses 200 distinct complete natural player commands, at least 30 active-draft clarification/amendment/cancellation conversations, 50 naturally phrased ambiguity cases, and 50 refusal/authority/unsupported/false-positive traps. Five-case batches receive at most two bounded retries. All 300 base rows persist the exact player utterance, style category, optional dialogue context, expected/actual plan, and safety result under the certification run with a SHA-256 receipt. If a failure cluster or confidence gap appears, run at most 100 fresh cases targeted only at that class; do not repeat the base corpus.
campaignCommand.lightVerificationPolicy: When credible prior Campaign Command depth already exists and the task is explicitly gap-focused, Verification Lab may run a 40-case risk-stratified light smoke: 26 complete natural commands, 6 ambiguity cases, 8 safety traps, and at least 5 active-draft follow-ups. The smoke must be perfect across interpretation and every safety dimension. It is diagnostic final-fingerprint evidence and does not masquerade as the full 300-row launch certificate.
campaignCommand.naturalLanguageLaunchGate: Launch requires one clean full final-fingerprint pass, at least 98% overall natural-player and multi-turn accuracy, 100% corpus/audit coverage, and 100% schema, authority, identifier, refusal, unsupported-action, persistence, and safety gates. Deterministic coverage includes all 20 native capability receipts, focused materially distinct composite/geography flows, ten diverse seeded five-year simulations unless variance is unstable, one combined native 30-day soak, and targeted recovery cases. Save roundtrip requires a guarded campaign-test restart receipt proving a different native game instance.

spymaster.appointment: The guarded appointment profile opens the native Spymaster screen, waits up to 60 seconds for the production court session to be server-aligned, selects a deterministic eligible adult courtier through the shared UI automation seam, and calls the same server-validated court office assignment path as the player UI before running smoke assertions.
spymaster.appointmentIdempotency: If a living, active, free Spymaster is already appointed, appointment is observational and retains that incumbent.
spymaster.prepareCheckpointOwnership: The organic prepare profile stages only its save-backed evidence ledger and next five-day observation boundary. It never writes a fixed native save; the guarded campaign-test Current checkpoint owns all save creation and rollback.
spymaster.savePrepareCheckpointOwnership: The organic save_prepare profile is observational and captures only the combined pre-reload evidence snapshot. The caller must then stop and drain the enrolled campaign test, overwrite its exact run-owned Current checkpoint through reign_checkpoint_campaign_test, and restart that Current through reign_restart_campaign_test before save_verify.
spymaster.legacySavePrepareCleanup: The guarded checkpoint-deletion host accepts exactly Reign_Spymaster_Organic_Midrun_A with exact expected prefix Reign_Spymaster_Organic_ solely to recover a save created by the retired fixed-save save_prepare scenario. No other Reign_ save is authorized by this exception.
spymaster.socialItemSelection: The guarded select-social-item UI action awaits the production server-backed rumor/reputation refresh before selecting an applicable record; fixed sleeps are not treated as readiness evidence.
spymaster.heroTargetEligibility: Every Spymaster hero-target list excludes dead or inactive heroes so visible UI selection and automation match production mission-resolution eligibility; a target can still become unavailable naturally after submission and must then cancel with durable evidence.
spymaster.agentActivationBoundaryFixture: The guarded activation fixture accepts -29 through -100 so acceptance can check the adjacent below/exact/above -30 sponsor-hostility boundary. It requires an exact armed campaignTestRunId and derives the run-owned Current, timeline, prefix, and protected baseline through the campaign-test service; callers cannot nominate a save or infer disposable status from a prefix. It sets the native Bannerlord relation first and then both authoritative underlying directional affinities, which are the exact values consumed by foreign-agent activation; using effective-value conversion here would drift the tested boundary through unrelated social modifiers.
spymaster.npcStatDiscoveryExclusion: person_skills is intentionally excluded from launch-acceptance coverage because NPC stats are no longer hidden and the operation is slated for removal. Organic person-intelligence coverage uses relationship and rumor reports instead.
spymaster.socialMitigationTargeting: Organic mitigation selects an active foreign target with a live production rumor independently from an active foreign target with a live established reputation. Each candidate must come from a naturally succeeded fabrication mission and is revalidated through the production social-status endpoint before UI selection; the harness never requires both independent random outcomes on one noble.
spymaster.socialFabricationTargetRotation: Repeated organic fabrication cycles select a fresh currently eligible foreign noble before reusing a prior mission target. This changes only semantic harness selection, not player UI ordering or production mission rules, and prevents probabilistic release evidence from clustering on one churn-prone hero.
spymaster.controlledSocialSuccess: The controlled_social_success profile submits moderate and severe fabrication through the visible production UI against a fresh active, free foreign noble, preferring a non-travelling non-ruler target to reduce unrelated native invalidation during the due window. It captures the exact production mission GUIDs and binds non-serialized one-shot outcome rolls only to those GUIDs. It preserves quote formulas and cannot affect normal campaigns or unrelated missions; use it for rare-branch correctness after natural probability evidence has been sampled.
spymaster.controlledRumorMitigation: After ordinary social_mitigation proves live record selection and native random outcomes, controlled_rumor_mitigation can prove the remaining rare successful-rumor branch. It submits one real UI mitigation, binds a one-shot roll only to that captured production mission GUID, advances twelve native days, and verifies success plus complete override consumption.
spymaster.controlledSelfMitigation: After ordinary self_mitigation records natural outcome and detection branches, controlled_self_mitigation submits player rumor and reputation mitigation through the visible production UI, binds zero rolls only to the two captured mission GUIDs, and verifies both production resolver successes plus complete override consumption.
spymaster.controlledAgentAction: After natural agent-watch sampling, controlled_agent_action binds one non-serialized zero roll to one exact active hidden agent's next due action opportunity. The server still applies the production 58% threshold, target/effect selection, persistence, and cooldown; the receipt records the production stable roll, applied roll, action id, and one-shot consumption.
spymaster.controlledCounterintelligence: After an active hidden agent has produced an operation, controlled_counterintelligence submits a real UI counterintelligence mission and binds a one-shot zero roll only to its captured production mission GUID. It verifies normal mission success, durable agent exposure, and attribution of recorded operations.
spymaster.controlledDestructiveBranches: After organic assassination failures have sampled production randomness, controlled_assassination_success and controlled_capture_breakout_success prove only the still-unseen destructive outcomes. Each profile runs on its own guarded Current restore branch, submits one production UI assassination, and binds non-serialized rolls to that exact mission GUID. The capture branch targets a governed foreign settlement so its settlement party is a durable native prisoner holder, then separately binds the production breakout roll only after the same mission has actually imprisoned the Spymaster. Production resolves party, target-settlement, home, clan-fief, and foreign-ruler holders in order and never marks attribution pending or reports capture unless native captivity actually occurs. Native death, captivity, escape, concealment, history, and memory effects remain real; restore the guarded Current after each evidence capture.
spymaster.evidence: UI snapshots expose the appointed hero id and display name; the following native smoke assertions prove office identity before any operation coverage.

arrest.languageCorpus: Exactly 36 manifest-owned natural player utterances cover proposal and second-turn confirmation, ambiguity, negation, correction, refusal, rescission, release, pronouns, titles, and indirect phrasing. The zero-tolerance safety classes must pass 100%; expand only when one semantic class fails.
arrest.policyTable: All four severities are proved once for justified and unsupported cause. Relationship correction is difference-based, so retries are idempotent, later evidence moves only between policy cells, and rescission removes the exact prior arrest relationship effect while deactivating the unique accusation reputation.
arrest.nativeAcceptance: Each mutating profile requires the exact active named disposable save. Town, castle, and party custody use Bannerlord TakePrisonerAction; surrender proves refusal and acceptance; duel consumes the production nonlethal completion seam; battle consumes native prisoner and escape events and must separately disclose whether an actual MapEvent was proven; protected/foreign escape uses native EndCaptivityAction; sovereignty transfers a fortification to a distinct foreign clan, proves custody remains with the settlement while player protection ends, and restores the original owner.

carryForwardScopes.campaign_checkpoint_restore_harness_only: Requires identical campaign enrollment, baseline, disposable save, client/server builds, provider configuration, and Bannerlord version; permits only MCP/catalog recovery-harness changes and carries language plus deterministic pass-once evidence.
carryForwardScopes.arrest_sovereignty_fixture_only: Requires identical campaign enrollment, baseline, disposable save, server build, provider configuration, and Bannerlord version plus a changed client build; permits only the client sovereignty-migration behavior and its native fixture, plus the MCP/catalog carry audit, to change. It carries language plus deterministic pass-once evidence and never carries native, cleanup, or save/reload evidence.

arrest.organicSaveAuthorization: Organic arrest profiles accept either a dedicated Reign_ feature save or the exact active ReignTest_ Current save created by a guarded campaign-test enrollment. The native host must match the supplied name to Bannerlord's active loaded save slot before any fixture or organic effect executes; a last-save-operation receipt is not accepted as loaded-save identity and the check remains valid immediately after restart.
arrest.cleanup: Every native fixture uses an arrest_test_ namespace, rescinds its server-side social effect, releases the exact target, removes only its own case, and restores any temporary settlement owner before returning.

residentEscape.policy: Before outbreak clan transfers and war callbacks, threatened free noble residents without parties escape automatically on the rebel side and with one stable 25% roll per noble on the loyalist side. Prefer safe own-side home or clan towns/castles; otherwise go into hiding. Existing captives, mobile parties, the main hero and foreign/non-noble residents are excluded.
residentEscape.offlineEvidence: Canonical changed validation executes the production planner contracts and callback-order guard; licensed client compilation checks native relocation bindings. No provider calls or native mutations.
residentEscape.nativeEvidence: Guarded run-owned disposable Current outbreak, native hero/settlement/governor/prisoner/party observations, saved ExecutionSnapshotJson.residentEscape receipts, and checkpoint/reload persistence. Existing rebellion certification cases do not independently certify resident relocation.
residentEscape.acceptanceGate: Native relocation, both loyalist roll outcomes, family/governor cleanup, no-safe-holding hiding and persistence remain pending until observed after exact-artifact deployment. Never infer native acceptance from offline tests.

rebellion.proofSelection: One authoritative proof per distinct state transition or failure mode. Equivalent channel, timing, ruler-transition, and verdict permutations are not repeated.
rebellion.correspondenceQuiescence: Each mail turn is delivered independently. After the concern-sampling letter, and again after the decisive follow-up, certification advances six native days and inserts wait_for_correspondence, requiring the client-observed correspondence tick count to remain zero for 25 seconds. During guarded passive-world advancement only, Reign's standard letter-arrival inquiry is dismissed as Not Now so notification UI cannot stop unattended time. The wait is bounded to 600 seconds and fails closed.
rebellion.languageCorpus: Exactly 11 compact natural-language cases cover direct and mail pledge/refusal/reporting plus ambiguity, negation, and correction. The six organic cases are bounded two-turn exchanges: the opening request samples the noble's concerns, then a natural follow-up answers identity, plan, risk, and terms and asks only for support or refusal. Report cases and the native travel sequence never tell, invite, or coach the NPC to report. Production supplies authoritative sovereign identity, NPC-to-sovereign and NPC-to-player relations, Reign Loyalty, and native Honor. Eligible reporting is a concealed private action: the visible reply may contain only refusal or guarded neutrality while actionGate uses commitment=final_private_report or a visible refused commitment plus explicit non-negated private report intent. The server accepts that intent only for the NPC's own sovereign, relation at least +10, and either Loyalty at least 61 or positive Honor; ineligible report intent fails closed. The immediate result is indistinguishable from refusal and only the delayed ruler summons reveals the report. Every decisive follow-up repeats that the request concerns rebellion against the ruler; pledge follow-ups name allied leaders and the exact promised holding. Pledge requires an actionable accepted commitment. An unconditional final refusal requires actionGate.needed=true with commitment=refused. Negotiation or deferral requires actionGate.needed=false with commitment=conditional and persists nothing; a refused label without an actionable gate also fails closed. Natural final future-tense and nominal forms such as I'll pledge, we will pledge, or that's my pledge route to secret preparation, never immediate declaration. Normalized contraction forms such as cant/can t, wont/won t, and dont/don t remain explicit negations. A reply beginning with a standalone No is a refusal only after report and positive-pledge recognition have failed; explicit final phrases such as will not throw my clan and stands aside also resolve refusal after scene-setting prose, while negotiation-only no land/no gold does not. Persisted provenance maps the production-normalized in_person/in person channel to individual_chat and preserves correspondence distinctly. Mail cases temporarily enroll the exact known recipient clan leader under the fixture sovereign, dispatch the concern-sampling letter, advance and quiesce, then dispatch the decisive follow-up, advance and quiesce again before observing the decision. Dispatch alone is never reply evidence, and guarded notice dismissal never opens a reply or supplies evidence. Clarification or negotiation is not a decision. The server-only contract credits only the five language_contract adapters; the six direct/mail cases require their own visible Individual Chat or Correspondence reports. Direct decision actions are rejected as evidence.
rebellion.profileIsolation: Smoke and feature are observational. Every mutating profile requires the exact active guarded campaign-test Current save and emits distinct fail-closed assertions rather than a shared smoke snapshot.
rebellion.reportFixture: RB-LANG-003, RB-LANG-006, and RB-NATIVE-001 native_setup temporarily enroll living, free leaders of active non-ruling vassal clans accepted by the production pledge action. It sets them to at most -10 toward the player, at least +35 toward their current sovereign, and Honor at least +1; records exact clan-leader identity plus prior and applied relation/Honor values; and relies on guarded checkpoint reload for restoration. These moderate values satisfy the production plausibility gate without defining the NPC's final choice. The configured model sees the sovereign-grounded context and decides from natural player turns; no decision action or prompt directive is injected.
rebellion.persistence: travel_prepare requires a production natural-language report and stages its exact plot marker. The separate reign_checkpoint_campaign_test route owns the pause, quiescence, Save Sync, and rolling Current checkpoint. After guarded restart and native advancement, travel_verify proves report travel, summons delivery, current-ruler/informer identity, the seven-day deadline, and linked save-authoritative state.
rebellion.nativeAcceptance: mixed_transfer applies the production exile verdict to one disposable mixed holding with a town, castle, and bound villages. foreign_reintegration uses production declaration, recruitment, kingdom movement, leadership-bound resolution, and origin restoration to prove a foreign clan and every living family member return exactly once.
rebellion.recruitmentLockout: Once a conspiracy is reported or a ruler summons is in flight, further secret recruitment is rejected.
rebellion.carryForward: Only already-proven language and deterministic cases explicitly marked passOnce may cross runs, and only by preserving their durable report references when campaign enrollment, baseline, disposable save, source, client, server, provider, catalog, and Bannerlord fingerprints are identical. Server-only contract evidence can directly credit only language_contract cases. Native, save/load, transfer, reintegration, and cleanup evidence is never carried.
rebellion.evidence: Prepared state and reports bind exact enrollment/fingerprints, manifest case, natural player turns, visible channel, action correlation, production plot/pledge/summons/movement/membership records, native holding and family identities, save/load stages, no-bypass audit, and cleanup status.

socialReputation.focusedReportContract: reign_get_social_reputation_test_report accepts optional caseId and includeSnapshots=false to retrieve filtered authoritative case evidence without full campaign or longitudinal snapshots. Omitted arguments preserve full-export compatibility. The reportFilter records intentional omission; no evidence is deleted. Each forced preparation creates new native events. Reports retain preparationEventCount, uniqueSourceCount, currentPreparationEventIds, currentPreparationOccurrenceCount and historicalOccurrenceCount. Exact native producer sequences scope current receipt completion and exactly two new occurrences, while two established favorites may retain prior activation history. Missing run enrollment is rejected normally before campaign access. Favor projection verifies the unrounded collapsed favor contribution separately from unrelated standing sources and checks the rounded complete total; isolated regression checks reject double charges, incorrect totals, and premature rounding.
socialReputation.saveIsolation: Social Reputation prepare and execution require an explicit campaignTestRunId. MCP derives the exact guarded run-owned Current save, prefix, timeline, and protected baseline; the client independently compares Bannerlord's active native slot before mutation. The older Reign_SocialBalance_ namespace remains accepted only for already-enrolled legacy evidence.
socialReputation.signalContract: The signal_contract profile opens the visible production Individual Chat UI and sends one explicit flirtation plus one natural hypothetical control through the configured dialogue model. The server exposes accepted and rejected normalized signal evidence, verifies stable exchange IDs and persisted court_social_signal_evidence rows, and alone records the pass/fail result.
socialReputation.playerFlirtContract: The player_flirt profile opens visible production Individual Chat, sends one explicit natural player flirtation through the configured model, closes the conversation, and requires the server to join the validated response signal to compact persisted turn evidence, the close-time court producer receipt, target history, native speaker clan tier, and the unmodified production chance/roll. A failed natural exposure roll is recorded honestly and does not invalidate the validated producer contract.
socialReputation.playerAffairContract: The player_affair profile sends the bounded native roster to a read-only server ranker and selects only a living adult opposite-sex NPC married to someone other than the player whose authoritative Reign Honor and Loyalty are both in the very-low 0-20 band. Missing profiles use the same deterministic in-memory personality projection as production and are not materialized merely by ranking. The profile records and later restores bounded native relation and mutual Reign underlying-affinity fixtures on the exact enrolled disposable save, introduces the tier-6 player naturally, and offers a concrete royal advisory office that remains independent of intimacy plus an explicitly consequence-free, consensual, discreet affair through visible production Individual Chat. A bounded negotiation reads each actual NPC reply, answers requested role, security, discretion, trust, time, named compensation, and trial-period concerns in natural player language, explicitly accepts NPC-authored concrete terms without making office benefits conditional on intimacy, asks what remains instead of repeating an unchanged proposition, and preserves every turn. Clarification, conditions, attraction, and negotiation are not consent. The final invitation reiterates that office, income, protection, and freedom to refuse remain unconditional. After the NPC explicitly accepts, one separate natural fade-forward turn rechecks continuing consent and lets the NPC confirm the completed private scene; the harness accepts the pregnancy-risk gate only after that authoritative completion response. The server alone awards a pass after independently re-reading the target's persisted very-low Honor/Loyalty, joining the exact validated sexual_intimacy_completed signal to persistent evidence, proving married-to-another eligibility, exactly one production exposure receipt, the unchanged tier-scaled chance/roll, an active exposed Affair occurrence, and restoration of both relationship layers. Model refusal or a natural exposure miss remains failure evidence and is never manually asserted as a pass.
socialReputation.promptOverridePolicy: After ordinary model behavior has been sampled, player_affair may opt into promptOverrideAssisted for deterministic capability proof. Natural player text remains unchanged while a separate one-request directive is accepted only when the server revalidates the armed live-test run, exact executing player_affair command, prepared Social Reputation enrollment, current game instance, and active Reign_SocialBalance_ disposable save. Every response returns an authorization receipt with request_only scope. The mode is rejected for every other profile, never changes global prompts, and cannot count as an independent model-acceptance sample.
socialReputation.unchasteContract: The unchaste profile selects one ordinary adult female lord and one ordinary adult male lord, creates one publicly known illegitimate child linked to both inside the exact enrolled disposable save, and invokes the production court-personality producer for each parent. Because the natural seasonal exposure chance is 5%, the harness binds forced exposure and promotion only to those two exact run-owned production occurrences, records the source keys and child linkage, drains World History through their sequence, and lets only the server award a pass after independently joining both occurrences and proving zero rumor value plus established reputation values of -50 for the mother and -5 for the father. The forced fixture is never serialized as a production probability change and never affects another save or occurrence.
socialReputation.npcFavoringPresenceContract: The npc_favoring_presence profile selects one real non-player ruler and one distinct real adult NPC, co-locates them only inside the enrolled disposable save, and exercises the same extracted ruler/favorite pair processor used by the production daily roster scan. Existing attached JSON records are mutated in place and only newly created records are inserted, preserving streak state across days. Its evidence records the pair-processor revision and exact bounded call count. It proves an interrupted streak resets to one, day ten produces no event, and day eleven queues the exact parameterized Ruler Favoring event. The rare exposure/promotion branch is forced only for that exact run-owned ruler/favorite/day source key; World History and the social-outcome receipt must drain before the server independently proves the active occurrence, linked favorite, -5 rumor/-10 established values, and the unchanged five-percent base chance with native clan-tier scaling.
socialReputation.playerFavoringDialogueContract: The player_favoring_dialogue profile is a conversation count and per-target isolation test. It requires the enrolled main hero to be the active ruler and selects two distinct real adult NPCs only after the production dialogue-history route verifies a clean persisted dialogue history for each. It sends six visible configured-model Individual Chat exchanges to the primary target and one to the independent control target, requires observable replies and normal close behavior, but does not grade conversational coherence because reply semantics do not affect this feature outcome. Provider-backed dialogue and party-chat response routes use a dedicated observable 900-second client timeout while control-plane routes retain their short deadlines; this multi-turn profile alone receives a 3600-second command deadline that the social-balance bridge preserves without widening unrelated command ceilings. The server proves six distinct exactly-once primary exchange receipts, one independent control-target counter and receipt with no threshold event, the player-ruler roster gate, clean target isolation, and one sixth-exchange production result with the unchanged ten-percent base chance times native clan-tier scaling. A natural exposure miss is retained honestly and passes the counter/formula contract when its chance and roll are complete; an exposure hit must also match the exact primary thread occurrence.
socialReputation.batchAcceptanceContract: The preflight profile records an explicitly bounded 15-case non-focused sample only after the server deterministic rumor/reputation suite passes, the native snapshot contains the supported player, ruler, vassal-clan-leader, regular-lord, and at least 1000 adult-NPC categories, and a bounded production-formula scale probe evaluates 12 ruler views across 1000 NPCs within its recorded deadline. This sample is subsystem proof and does not by itself satisfy full Social Reputation release readiness. Every completed social_snapshot command is persisted by the shared live completion hook before the following profile command is evaluated. The isolated deterministic suite runs once on a worker task keyed to the exact enrollment. If the controller's bounded completion request is retried, every retry joins that same task instead of restarting a fresh temporary campaign; authoritative completion recording is serialized and cached for the run. favoring_rebellion uses exact run-owned declaration, resolution, and cleanup fixtures, requires the compatible favoring projection, performs one real non-player native ruler transition, and restores the original ruler immediately. longitudinal_90_day stores structured native/server snapshots at caller-driven guarded day 0, 30, 60, and 90 checkpoints and records its six cases only after at least 89.5 days with bounded social-state growth and ruler turnover. Release readiness returns explicit ready, verdict, blockerCount, and blockers fields.
socialReputation.favoringProjectionContract: The favoring_projection profile selects one real non-player ruler, two distinct same-kingdom favorites that are verified to share the native fixture after immediate teleport, a distinct same-kingdom non-favorite observer, and a foreign observer. It tries eligible candidates in stable order, records each bounded relocation result, and fails with those diagnostics if fewer than two can actually co-locate. Inside the exact enrolled disposable save it drives both ruler/favorite pairs through the same native day-eleven production state machine and exact run-owned exposure/promotion seam, then drains both World History sequences. The server alone records a pass after joining both completed receipts and parameterized established reputations, proving that Public Standing collapses the two global Ruler Favoring costs to one Charm-mitigated -10 contribution, each named favorite receives +15, the same-kingdom non-favorite receives the exact Charm-and-Jealousy-scaled penalty, the foreign observer receives zero, and resolving all four views creates no relationship pair.
socialReputation.favoringJealousyCharmContract: The favoring_jealousy_charm profile reuses compatible passed favoring_projection evidence on the same campaign/timeline rather than producing duplicate occurrences. The server selects real same-kingdom non-favorite observers at the low and high ends of the current saved Jealousy distribution, verifies the exact 0.5 plus Jealousy/100 factor and the 0.5-1.5 mathematical boundaries, applies the subject's current native Charm mitigation, verifies player-neutral Jealousy, favorite +15, foreign suppression, and proves that every observer read leaves relationship-pair counts unchanged.
socialReputation.playerParityContract: The player_parity profile requires compatible passed player Flirt, player Affair, and ordinary male/female Unchaste cases on the same campaign and timeline. It creates one run-owned publicly known illegitimate child with the enrolled adult ruler player as a biological parent and invokes the same native court-personality Unchaste producer used for NPCs.
